chronology.notes: A likely hiatus occurs at 315 cm at the transtion from calcareous silts to overlying organic sediments (Hope & Peterson 1976). Thus, the sedimentation rate based on the linear fit to the dates at 962 cm and 475 cm was extrapolated to 317 cm. This extrapolated age was then inserted as an age control to enable a single age model for the entire sequence based on linear interpolation.

Based on the IntCal13 calibration curve. A likely hiatus occurs at 315 cm at the transtion from calcareous silts to overlying organic sediments (Hope & Peterson 1976). Thus, a hiatus was set at 315 cm. Because the age of the bottommost sample at 980 cm was poorly extrapolated by Bacon (it was set equal to the age at 960 cm), the age at 980 was estimated by extrapolation with the mean sedimentation rate between 960 and 900 cm.
